nina: FYI: Beacon Retail (acct BR-447) flagged by product analytics  sudden drop in active users for recommendations API. Renewal in 9 days, low onboarding score.

devon: How big is the exposure?

nina: ~$29k ARR. Missed post-onboard check, NPS 4, two quick-start tickets unresolved.

ash: Any error spikes or auth issues?

nina: No errors. Usage shifted from recommender -> embeddings-only calls; sessions per key down 48%.

devon: Proposed save flow: 1) Immediate outreach + short survey to understand why usage dropped. 2) Offer a focused enablement clinic (30m). 3) Provide a one-click config patch for caching & batching. 4) 14-day trial credits if they run the patch and accept clinic.

nina: Draft checklist (owners).
```
- outreach email + short survey (owner: devon, within 24h)
- enablement clinic 30m (owner: ash)
- config patch & rollback plan (owner: ash)
- quick audit of top endpoints (owner: nina)
- attach save-plan to timeline & set 48h follow-up (owner: devon)
```

ash: I'll prepare the patch (small diff) and include a before/after token est.

cse_bot: Account snapshot linked: https://redwood.app/account/BR-447/health | onboarding 35/100. Auto-reminder set for follow-up in 48h.

nina: Outreach sent. Will update when survey responses arrive.

devon: If no response in 48h escalate to AM lead.

nina: Closing loop: tagging as 'rapid save-play' and creating account task.
